Game Overview

In Thor King Pig, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling journey as Thor, battling the cunning King Pig in a vibrant pixel world. Dodge enemies, master powerful ax throws, and navigate treacherous terrains. Prioritize survival by reaching the escape door while collecting diamonds for added challenges. Choose your controls and dive into epic adventures.
